'''''Visnea''''' is a [[monotypic genus]] of [[flowering plant]]s in family [[Pentaphylacaceae]].<ref>{{Citation |last=Stevens |first=P.F.  |title=Angiosperm Phylogeny Website |url=http://www.mobot.org/MOBOT/research/APweb/ |access-date=2014-09-18 }}</ref> The genus contains a single species, '''''Visnea mocanera''''' a tree native to the [[Canary Islands]] and [[Madeira]].<ref name="POWO">{{cite web |title=''Visnea'' L.f. {{!}} Plants of the World Online {{!}} Kew Science |url=https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:39153-1 |website=Plants of the World Online |access-date=8 January 2022 |language=en}}</ref>

The fruits of the tree (known as ''Mocan'') are edible.<ref name="Hernández">{{cite journal |last1=Hernández-Pérez |first1=Margarita |last2=Frı́as |first2=Juana |last3=Rabana |first3=Rosa |last4=Vidal-Valverde |first4=Concepción |title=Proximate Composition of "Mocan" (Visnea mocanera L.f.): A Fruit Consumed by Canary Natives Author links open overlay panell |journal=Journal of Food Composition and Analysis |date=September 1994 |volume=7 |issue=3 |pages=203–207|doi=10.1006/jfca.1994.1020 }}</ref><ref>Marcelino J. del Arco Aguilar and Octavio Rodríguez Delgado {{google books|PYxlDwAAQBAJ|Vegetation of the Canary Islands (2018 )|page=321}}</ref>

The genus name of ''Visnea'' is in honour of Gérard de Visme (c. 1725 – c. 1797), a French and English merchant in [[Lisbon]], Portugal.<ref>{{cite book | last=Burkhardt | first=Lotte | title=Verzeichnis eponymischer Pflanzennamen – Erweiterte Edition |trans-title=Index of Eponymic Plant Names – Extended Edition | publisher=Botanic Garden and Botanical Museum, Freie Universität Berlin | year=2018 | isbn=978-3-946292-26-5 |language=German |location=Berlin | doi=10.3372/epolist2018 | s2cid=187926901 }}</ref> The genus was first described by [[Carl Linnaeus the Younger]] in 1782, and published in Suppl. Pl. on page 36.<ref name="POWO"/>

Note; ''Visnea'' <small>Steud. ex Endl.</small> is a [[Synonym (taxonomy)|synonym]] of ''[[Barbacenia]]'', a genus in a different family.<ref name=WCSP_300122>{{citation |title=''Barbacenia''|work=[[World Checklist of Selected Plant Families]] |publisher=[[Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew]] |url=http://wcsp.science.kew.org/namedetail.do?name_id=300122 |access-date=2018-02-10}}</ref>

==Fossil record==
Four [[fossil]] seeds of a ''Visnea'' sp. have been described from [[middle Miocene]] [[strata]] of the Fasterholt area near [[Silkeborg]] in Central [[Jutland]], [[Denmark]].<ref>Angiosperm Fruits and Seeds from the Middle Miocene of Jutland (Denmark) by [[Else Marie Friis]], The Royal Danish Academy of Sciences and Letters 24:3, 1985</ref>
